name: UiPath
description: UiPath is an enterprise automation platform combining robotic process automation (RPA), AI agents, and process orchestration to automate and test complex business scenarios.
best_for: Enterprises in regulated industries like banking, healthcare, and insurance that need to automate repetitive processes and scale RPA and agentic automation across departments.
features: Studio Desktop (Windows) and browser-based Studio Web for building automations
AI-powered RPA robots for attended and unattended task execution
Maestro orchestration platform for coordinating complex, long-running workflows
Intelligent Document Processing (IXP) for extracting data from documents
Process mining and task mining to discover automation opportunities
Test Cloud and agentic testing for automated application testing
Action Center for human-in-the-loop approvals on long-running workflows
Automation Cloud SaaS or self-hosted Automation Suite across cloud, on-premises, or hybrid

alternatives.name: Power Automate

alternatives.name: Zapier
alternatives.description: A no-code automation platform that connects thousands of web apps through simple trigger-and-action workflows.

alternatives.name: Zoho Flow
